City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2019 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by SWPPP Interns/Students from Diegueno Middle School
4B.
Presentation of $5,000 donation to the City by Patrons of Encinitas Parks
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a WHITE speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 13, 2019 Regular Meeting, February 13, 2019 Special Meeting, February 20, 2019 Regular Meeting and February 20, 2019 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-03-13 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-03-13 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2019-05 amending Chapter 9.21 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to implement State regulations (via the Bureau of Cannabis Control) requiring Cities to authorize cannabis deliveries (not businesses) within their respective boundaries. Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2019-05 entitled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California amending Chapter 9.21 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Authorize Cannabis Delivery (not businesses) pursuant to State Law.”
2019-03-13 Item 08C Adoption of Ordinance No. 2019-05 for Cannabis Deliveries
8D.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance 2019-02, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Adding Chapter 9.55 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding Pilot Shared Mobility Program.” Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
1. Adopt City Council Ordinance 2019-02, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Adding Chapter 9.55 to the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding Pilot Shared Mobility Program.”
2019-03-13 Item 08D Adoption of Mobility Ordinance No 2019-02
8E.
Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the General Plan. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter and Management Analyst Piano-Jones
Staff recommends that the Council approve the General Plan Annual Progress Report.
2019-03-13 Item 08E General Plan Progress Report (2018)
8F.
Approve Recommendation from the Commission for the Arts for Artistic Elements at the Santa Fe Drive Undercrossing. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
Approve the recommendation of the Commission for the Arts for the artistic element designs on the redesigned interchanges on Interstate 5 at Santa Fe Drive.
2019-03-13 Item 08F Santa Fe Undercrossing Public Art Recommendation
8G.
Approve Locations for the Sculpture Installation Program. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
Approve the recommendation of the Commission for the Arts for the locations of the Sculpture Installation Program.
2019-03-13 Item 08G Sculpture Installation Program
8H.
The Preparation and Filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Report. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-14 entitled, “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Directing the Preparation and Filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Report for the Purposes of Levying and Collecting Assessments for Fiscal Year 2019-2020.”
2019-03-13 Item 08H Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District
8I.
GO by BIKE Mini-Grant Agreement and Capital Improvement Program budget adjustment to conduct bike safety outreach. Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
1) Accept the GO by BIKE mini-grant of $3,000 for bike safety outreach from SANDAG; 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-22 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget”; 3) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a GO by BIKE mini-grant agreement with SANDAG (in substantial form to receive $3,000 in grant funding for bike safety outreach; and 4) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract for services with Rider Safety Visibility (in substantial form) to conduct bike safety marketing and outreach in support of the SANDAG GO by BIKE mini-grant.
2019-03-13 Item 08I Bike Outreach Grant
8J.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer: Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
STRATEGIC
2019-03-13 Item 08J Mobility Update
8K.
Professional Services Contract with Scott Associates to perform special tax assessments for Community Facilities District No. 1 (CFD) and administrative and support services for the Cardiff and Encinitas Sanitary Divisions (CSD and ESD). Contact Person: Finance Analyst Attili and Senior Management Analyst Wilson
That City Council take the following action: Authorize the City Manager or her designee in coordination with the City Attorney to execute a professional services contract with Scott Associates for a term of three years beginning with fiscal year (FY) 2019-20 with an option to extend the agreement for two additional one-year periods for a total term of five years and a not to exceed amount of $149,174.
2019-03-13 Item 08K Scott and Associates Contract FY 12-2020-2022
8L.
Public Hearing to consider funding recommendations for eligible activities under the FY 2019-20 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
Staff recommends the following actions: 1) Authorize funding for activities in Attachment "1" and in the Analysis Section of the Agenda Report, for incorporation into the draft FY 2019-20 Annual Action Plan; and 2) Continue the Public Hearing to April 24, 2019 to gather public input prior to Council's approval of the FY 2019-20 CDBG budget and the FY 2019-20 Annual Action Plan.
2019-03-13 Item 08L CDBG Funding
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Development Services Director's approval of a two-lot subdivision for the property located at 2218 13th Street and associated improvements. CASE NUMBER: 17-206 TPM; APPLICANT: Lewis Bernard Massie; APPELLANT: Darren Kimble c/o The Law Office of Julie M. Hamilton; LOCATION: 2218 13th Street (APN: 264-143-41). Contact Person: Associate Planner Mierau
This item appears on the agenda because both the applicant and the appellant had agreed to continue the public hearing to the March 13, 2019 City Council meeting. This item is currently in the City's mediation program and will be rescheduled at a later date if necessary.
10B.
Public Hearing to consider a series of actions to update and implement the City's Housing Element Update 2019, related General Plan, Specific Plan, Zoning, and Local Coastal Program amendments and the associated Environmental Assessment; Case No. 17-128 GPA/SPA/LCPA. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-19, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, repealing in its entirety the Uncertified Housing Element of the General Plan and adopting in full new text comprising the 2013-2021 Housing Element Update to the General Plan and adopting conforming and ancillary amendments to the Local Coastal Program, Land Use Element of the General Plan, and the Voter's Rights Initiative portion of the Land Use Element."; 2) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-04, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code (EMC) Title 30, Zoning to provide use and development standards to implement the new General Plan Land Use Designation, and repeal mid-range density provisions and non-objective Design Review Findings, making assorted changes required for consistency elsewhere
in the Municipal and Zoning codes, approving Local Coastal Program Implementation Program Amendments, amending EMC Chapter 30.00 Encinitas Right to Vote Amendment to allow various changes including a change in maximum building height standards to accommodate three-story buildings on the sites designated in the General Plan and Zoning Map, and amending the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, and Encinitas Ranch Specific Plans to amend the Zoning Maps in those Specific Plans and to provide use and development standards to implement the new General Plan Land Use Designation and provide for Housing Element implementation."; and 3) Direct staff to file all necessary material to the state Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) to certify the 2013-2021 Housing Element and to the State of California Coastal Commission to amend the Encinitas Local Coastal Program.
2019-03-13 Item 10B Housing Element Update Report & Attachments
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Information report on the status of the Leucadia North Highway 101 Streetscape Project. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Receive the oral report and provide direction as necessary.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 20, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
